summary: I adopt the preceding Astra assessment after reading the exact candidate and report, re-deriving its certificate implications, and running targeted new exact checks. The balanced stability constants, bounded AB cost law and 22-form six-level formula are supported. Original accept and score 4 are retained; no material disagreement was found. The larger hive and finite-set replay remains evidence from the preceding agent, with its original limits preserved. The N=8 reflected-Weyl wording remains a minor presentational finding.
